tools.name: waitwhile_list_locations
tools.description: List the account's locations (businesses/sites): id, name, short name, address, time zone, opening hours and waitlist/booking settings. Use the ids to filter visits, services and resources. GET /locations.

tools.name: waitwhile_get_location
tools.description: One location by id or short name (the part of its public Waitwhile URL). GET /locations/{shortNameOrId}.

tools.name: waitwhile_list_location_status
tools.description: Live status of every location: open/closed, number of people waiting and being served, current estimated wait time, and booking counters. GET /location-status.

tools.name: waitwhile_get_location_status
tools.description: Live status of one location: open/closed, waiting and serving counts, estimated wait. GET /location-status/{locationId}.

tools.name: waitwhile_list_visits
tools.description: List visits: waitlist entries (people in line) and bookings (appointments), with customer, state (PENDING, DRAFT, BOOKED, WAITING, SERVING, COMPLETE), tags (e.g. NO-SHOW, CANCELLED, ARRIVED), services, resources, party size, position and timestamps. Filter by location, state, tag, customer, service,

tools.name: waitwhile_search_visits
tools.description: Search visits by a prefix match on customer name, phone, e-mail or customer id, optionally filtered by location, state, tag and excluded tags. Page-numbered. Contains customer contact details. GET /visits/search.

tools.name: waitwhile_get_visit
tools.description: One visit (waitlist entry or booking) by id: customer, state, tags, services, resources, party size, position, estimated wait and all timestamps. GET /visits/{visitId}.

tools.name: waitwhile_list_booking_slots
tools.description: Booking slots of a location for a date range with the free spots per resource and service, so you can see when an appointment can be booked. Dates are local to the location, YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm. GET /visits/availability.

tools.name: waitwhile_first_available_slots
tools.description: The first available booking slots of a location (optionally for a party size, services and resources) from a date. Use it to propose appointment times. GET /visits/first-available-slots.

tools.name: waitwhile_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (name, phone, e-mail, tags, last visit per location, created/updated). Cursor-paged, 20 per page by default; filter by location, external id or created/updated date. Contains personal data. GET /customers.

tools.name: waitwhile_search_customers
tools.description: Search customers by a prefix match on name, phone, e-mail or customer id; optionally narrowed by location, visit state or tag. Page-numbered. Contains personal data. GET /customers/search.

tools.name: waitwhile_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id: contact details, tags, per-location state and last visit. Contains personal data. GET /customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: waitwhile_list_customer_notes
tools.description: The staff notes recorded on a customer (content, author, visit and location, timestamps). GET /customers/{customerId}/notes.

tools.name: waitwhile_list_services
tools.description: List services (what customers book or queue for): name, duration, price, locations, resources and category structure. GET /services.

tools.name: waitwhile_get_service
tools.description: One service by id. GET /services/{serviceId}.

tools.name: waitwhile_list_resources
tools.description: List resources — the people, rooms, tables or equipment that serve customers: name, locations, services, availability flag and category structure. GET /resources.

tools.name: waitwhile_get_resource
tools.description: One resource by id. GET /resources/{resourceId}.

tools.name: waitwhile_resources_availability
tools.description: Working hours/availability of a location's resources on a date (e.g. who is working today). GET /resources/availability.

tools.name: waitwhile_list_data_fields
tools.description: List the custom data fields (intake/booking form questions) with type, options and where they apply. Use the ids to read answers on visits. GET /data-fields.

tools.name: waitwhile_get_data_field
tools.description: One data field by id. GET /data-fields/{dataFieldId}.

tools.name: waitwhile_list_users
tools.description: List the staff users of the account: name, e-mail, roles, locations. Password data and tokens are never returned. GET /users.

tools.name: waitwhile_list_messages
tools.description: List the SMS/e-mail messages Waitwhile sent to and received from customers: channel, recipient, body, delivery state (PENDING, BLOCKED, FAILED, DELIVERED, UNCONFIRMED, RECEIVED) and error. Filter by location, visit, customer, state or date. Contains personal data. This only reads; it cannot send. GE

tools.name: waitwhile_get_message
tools.description: One message by id. Contains personal data. GET /messages/{messageId}.

tools.name: waitwhile_visit_analytics
tools.description: Aggregated visit statistics for a period: visits, waitlisted, bookings, served, no-shows, cancellations, wait and serve duration quantiles, and breakdowns by location, resource, service, party size, user, day of week and hour of day. GET /analytics/visits (JSON).

tools.name: waitwhile_list_audit_entries
tools.description: The account's audit log: who changed what and when (visits, customers, locations, services, resources, users, messages). Filter by type, event, entity, location or date. GET /audit-entries.

tools.name: waitwhile_create_visit
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE visit at a location. Without a date it adds the customer to the waitlist; with a local date-time (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm) it creates a booking. Needs a location and at least a name, phone or e-mail. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two visits. Visit notes are not supported here (

tools.description: WRITE: change ONE visit — its state (e.g. WAITING to SERVING to COMPLETE, or BOOKED), add/remove tags (e.g. ARRIVED, CONFIRMED, NO-SHOW), booking date/duration or party size. tools.name: waitwhile_cancel_visit
tools.description: WRITE: cancel ONE visit (a waitlist entry or booking). Waitwhile sets its state to COMPLETE and adds the CANCELLED tag; the visit is kept, not deleted. By default the request asks Waitwhile to suppress the customer message; this may only stop the immediate cancellation notice, and scheduled reminder

tools.name: waitwhile_add_customer_note
tools.description: WRITE: add one staff note to a customer's record (optionally tied to a visit and location). Adds only; nothing is edited or sent to the customer. POST /customers/{customerId}/notes.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "waitwhile_list_users" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the staff users of the account: name, e-mail, roles, locations. Password data and tokens are never returned. GET /users.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: waitwhile_get_location, waitwhile_list_messages, waitwhile_get_message, waitwhile_list_audit_entries · Private data: waitwhile_list_visits, waitwhile_search_visits, waitwhile_get_customer, waitwhile_list_users, waitwhile_add_customer_note · Public sink: waitwhile_list_messages, waitwhile_create_visit, waitwhile_update_visit, waitwhile_cancel_visit, waitwhile_add_customer_note · Destructive: waitwhile_update_visit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: waitwhile_get_location, waitwhile_list_messages, waitwhile_get_message, waitwhile_list_audit_entries · Private data: waitwhile_list_visits, waitwhile_search_visits, waitwhile_get_customer, waitwhile_list_users, waitwhile_add_customer_note · Public sink: waitwhile_list_messages, waitwhile_create_visit, waitwhile_update_visit, waitwhile_cancel_visit, waitwhile_add_customer_note · Destructive: waitwhile_update_visit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
